distance_mean_policy: Metrics are computed per case, then averaged with equal case weight. Voxels are not pooled across cases. Non-finite ASD/HD95 stay in the set; the official mean is inf when any case is non-finite. finite_mean excludes those cases and is only a diagnostic.
std_policy: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) over finite values when at least two exist
spacing_source: NRRD space directions; no space units in the files
